# TalentBridge AI

> TalentBridge AI is a recruitment automation platform that connects US companies with qualified consultancy talent through n8n-powered workflows.

TalentBridge AI is an applicant tracking and candidate management platform built for staffing agencies and in-house recruiting teams. It centralizes open roles, candidate submissions, and interview pipelines, and uses n8n workflows to automate job ingestion, candidate notifications, and status syncing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and entry point to the platform.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create a TalentBridge AI account.
- [Recruitment Automation Guide](/guides/automation): Guide on the benefits of recruitment automation software versus manual candidate tracking, with a focus on n8n-driven workflows.
